assessment: Supported by a large set of complementary experiments, the authors convincingly show that the lncRNA T-REX17 is required for human definitive endoderm differentiation. T-REX17 function is not related to the adjacent SOX17 gene that lies in the same topological domain (TAD), implying a trans-acting role. The study is important because it sheds light on the stage-specific role of lncRNAs in cell lineage induction.
